description: Submit a product / tool / API / library / agent / model / dataset / hardware onto an existing company or organization. startup_slug or startup_id is required. Costs 5 credits. Strict format: third-person prose, no HTML/markdown, no listicle titles. Optional logo_url and screenshot_urls (up to 6) are fetched and stored automatically. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

description.description: Full description in third person, 20–400 words, plain text only

name.description: Product name (≤80 chars; no listicle words)

one_liner.description: One-sentence pitch in third person, 20–200 chars

pricing_details.description: Optional structured pricing (tiers, per-seat, per-token, etc.)

pricing_type.description: free | freemium | paid | subscription | one-time | usage-based | enterprise | open-source

product_type.description: web-app | mobile-app | desktop-app | api | cli | library | extension | mcp-server | agent | model | platform | dataset | hardware | plugin

startup_id.description: Parent company or organization UUID. Required unless startup_slug is set.

startup_slug.description: Slug of the parent company or organization (e.g. "anthropic" for Claude). Required unless startup_id is set.
